audit.root_cause: verifiers' browser integration does `from stagehand import AsyncStagehand`, but nothing caps stagehand: the env lists bare `stagehand` and verifiers[browser] requires `stagehand>=3.4.0`. A fresh resolve now picks stagehand 4.3.0, which no longer has AsyncStagehand (4.0.0 was uploaded 2026-08-10; the env was published 2026-03-16).
audit.evidence: result.json import error: `verifiers/legacy/envs/integrations/browser_env/modes/dom_mode.py line 12: from stagehand import AsyncStagehand -> ImportError: cannot import name 'AsyncStagehand'`; freeze.log:95 `stagehand==4.3.0`; src/prime__bb-demo/pyproject.toml:12 `"stagehand",` with no bound; PyPI verifiers 0.3.1 requires_dist `stagehand>=3.4.0; extra == "browser"`
audit.irl_fix: Pin `stagehand>=3.4,<4` in the env's pyproject. Upstream verifiers[browser] also needs a `<4` cap or a port to the stagehand 4 API.
